description: MUTATES Sendbird data: creates a group channel with the given members. Platform API: POST /group_channels.

channel_url.description: Custom channel URL; auto-generated if omitted.

custom_type.description: Custom type tag for the channel.

data.description: Additional structured data as a string (often JSON).

is_distinct.description: If true, reuse an existing channel with the same members instead of creating a duplicate.

is_public.description: If true, the channel is public (joinable without invitation).

user_ids.description: User ids to add as members of the new channel.

name: sendbird_create_group_channel
title: Create a group channel
